program.name: Women, Infants, and Children (WIC)
program.description:
WIC helps pregnant women, new moms, babies, and kids under 5 get free healthy food and nutrition support.

You'll get a WIC card to buy healthy foods like milk, eggs, fruits, and vegetables at stores that take WIC. You'll also get nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and health referrals.

At your certification appointment, WIC staff will look at your diet, health history, and current health to see if you need extra nutrition support.

To get started, fill out the online pre-application. A local WIC clinic will then contact you to set up your appointment.

documents.text: Proof of identity (ex: driver's license, state ID, passport)
Child's birth certificate or proof of age
Proof of Kansas residency (ex: lease, utility bill, or piece of mail with your address)
Proof of household income (ex: pay stubs, tax return, benefit award letter)
Proof of SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, or FDPIR benefits, if applicable (waives the income check)
